name: Onoya Azuki
source:
Part of unit Eme☆Kare

He refers to himself as a "proud knight", and mainly communicates through writing instead of speech.
It seems he refuses to speak to anyone besides his fellow "knights" and chosen "Princess".
Since he is very close to his grandfather, his way of speaking is...?
